title: An a.e. identity of weighted orientations yields the integer combination of the represented currents
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P, let R₁ = (M₁, θ₁, ξ₁), R₂ = (M₂, θ₂, ξ₂), R = (M, θ, ξ) be IMReps in U (Simon Ch. 6, 3.1) and p₁, p₂ ∈ ℤ. Suppose that for Hⁿ-a.e. x ∈ ℝ^P (Hⁿ = μHE[n]) the n-vectors satisfy 1_M(x)θ(x)ξ(x) = p₁1_{M₁}(x)θ₁(x)ξ₁(x) + p₂1_{M₂}(x)θ₂(x)ξ₂(x). Then for every test form ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U) (ω : TestFormOn U n) we have τ(R)(ω) = p₁τ(R₁)(ω) + p₂τ(R₂)(ω), where τ(R)(ω) = R.action ω = ∫_M θ(x)⟨ω(x), ξ(x)⟩ dHⁿ(x).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R₁ R₂ R : IMRep U n) (p₁ p₂ : ℤ), (∀ᵐ x ∂μHE[n], R.carrier.indicator (fun y => (R.mult y : ℝ) • R.orient y) x = (p₁ : ℝ) • R₁.carrier.indicator (fun y => (R₁.mult y : ℝ) • R₁.orient y) x + (p₂ : ℝ) • R₂.carrier.indicator (fun y => (R₂.mult y : ℝ) • R₂.orient y) x) → ∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, R.action (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) = (p₁ : ℝ) * R₁.action (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) + (p₂ : ℝ) * R₂.action (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n)
